description: Estimates what spending a budget on one pack usually returns: how many packs it buys, the average insured value pulled, the average cash back if every card is sold back, the average result, and the chance of at least one Rare or Epic. Use it when the user asks what to expect from spending an amount, or whether a pack is worth it; use get_pack for the pack's odds and top cards. Read-only; honest averages from Collector Crypt's live odds, not a promise, and real results swing a lot with few packs.

budget.description: Budget in US$, e.g. 250. Must cover at least one pack.

code.description: Pack code from list_packs, lowercase, e.g. pokemon_50, onepiece_250, soccer_100.

name: estimate_budget
title: What a budget usually returns
